_fcm: transport=fcm — push, works in background. Needs a Firebase project.
_direct: transport=direct — POST straight to the phone (LAN/Tailscale). direct_host optional (mDNS auto-discovers via the zeroconf pip package). direct_token = the shared secret shown in the phone's Direct settings.
_ntfy: transport=ntfy — publish to an ntfy topic the phone subscribes to.
